name: Halloween Party
description: This is a Halloween Party organized by ESN Porto for international students, taking place at Hard Club in Porto.
longDescription:
The Halloween Party is an event specifically for international students, organized by ESN Porto. It is scheduled to take place on Saturday, October 31, 2026.

The event will be held at the Hard Club, located at Rua de Olivença 27, 4000-369 Porto, Portugal. The start time for the party is 23:59.

Tickets for the Halloween Party are priced at €12.
